verdict.rationale: Datadog has a first-party "OpenTelemetry in Datadog" documentation page, and a customer reports using OTel to instrument Elixir apps that lack a Datadog SDK, so OpenTelemetry is a documented ingestion path. The pack gives only the page title and does not show direct OTLP endpoint ingestion or how first-class the support is. Missing for 10: evidence of direct OTLP ingestion (agentless OTLP endpoint or Agent OTLP receiver details), documentation depth on which signals are supported (traces/metrics/logs), parity with native SDK features, and independent hands-on corroboration of sending OTLP directly.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send telemetry directly over OTLP with first-class OpenTelemetry support

citations.quote: Had to use OTel for Elixir apps since there's no DD SDK for Elixir/Erlang.
